summary: Prepared independent synthetic PostgreSQL integration specifications for DB01 through DB12. Raw DB01 test has no repository-module import, so collection can reach the intended schema-missing RED layer before repository files exist.

coverage.DB01: effective-dates.spec.ts: overlapping/adjacent compensation ranges and two-session conflict
coverage.DB02: immutability.spec.ts: scoped clock replay/conflict and append-only denial
coverage.DB03: immutability.spec.ts: approved snapshot canonical bytes/hash and direct mutation denial
coverage.DB04: hash-bindings.spec.ts: synthetic rule remains draft and app-role promotion denial
coverage.DB05: immutability.spec.ts: finalized late child insert and cross-run reassignment denial
coverage.DB06: hash-bindings.spec.ts: scope/hash binding query and mismatched compensation hash rejection
coverage.DB07: transactions.spec.ts: rollback, audit atomicity, and stale version conflict
coverage.DB08: transactions.spec.ts: rollback and committed transactional outbox row
coverage.DB11: transactions.spec.ts: application role attributes, CREATE and TRUNCATE denial
